Chapter 7043: Dao Court Found

Chapter 7043: Dao Court Found

“Pop!” Immortals in Dusk felt a flattening power emanating from a certain point.

“A celestial immortal?” They became afraid.

“No, the fortress race found the dao court.” Someone said.

This caused everyone to rush in that direction.

“We gotta get something out of this.” This was on everyone’s mind.

“The fortress race can’t monopolize this.” An immortal said.

“That’s right, they already took the source, don’t even think about the dao court.” Others began to team up.

Although the fortress had a primordial immortal, other alliances could also call their own. The dao court was tempting enough for them.

Once they arrived, they found that the fortress race had drawn a boundary forbidding anyone else from getting through.

“Immortal Bronze and Ash-serpent.” They saw two celestial immortals from the fortress race and Vagabond Alliance.

“Go, ask for the ancestor.” They could only ask for help from more ancient beings.

“Fellow Daoists, don’t be foolish now or face the consequences.” Ash-serpent remained undaunted.

“You’re not the only primordial immortal in Heavenrealm.” A golden immortal said.

“True.” Ash-serpent said: “There are others, some stronger than I am. However, if initiated, this will be a battle to the death. Think carefully.”

“You sound confident.” Another uttered coldly.

“The battlefield is meant to kill those who deserve death, not you all. We will show mercy if you don’t interfere.” Ash-serpent said.

In reality, given the number of immortals present, they could overwhelm Ash-serpent and Bronze Immortal. However, no one wanted to risk death by going first.

Once they had primordial immortals on their side, they could attack without risking as much.

Meanwhile, Ash-serpent waited for Heavencrush to open the dao court. The machine had found the dao court but tried several attempts at opening to no avail.

“Rumble!” Heavencrush extended two long and bizarre mechanical arms, embracing space itself. Lightning surged forth from the arms, carrying the color of the heaven.

Lightning arcs appeared everywhere, illuminating the darkness. Alas, there was an empty spot preventing its spread - the dao court.

“Buzz.” The machine erupted with a fiery glow and became far stronger. Space twisted before its might as the half-arc wrapped around the missing piece.

“The power of a celestial immortal.” Immortals were amazed while watching the complex machine.

The red glow came from the gaps between the activated plates, hinting at the celestial source within.

Previously, many came to an agreement with the fortress race regarding the celestial source in exchange for the easier path through Ruin.

It turned out that Heavencrush had taken the celestial source. This clearly infuriated some immortals since they considered this a waste.

“Not an immortal, not a living being, what is it?” Someone said.
